name: Covenant Coding Sandbox
description: Covenant's public coding sandbox. Its Metaplex asset and selected publisher-reported audit-root records are publicly readable. Those records name a reported publisher and make payload changes detectable under an externally pinned key; they do not prove publisher identity, that every tool call or file write was recorded, that an underlying claim is true, or that the agent is safe. A Core Oracle plugin can gate configured asset lifecycle events; it does not gate general agent execution.
